:::{#thm-dist-mle}
#### Central limit theorem for MLEs

For $\iid$ data from a correctly specified model
satisfying regularity conditions
(including those of @thm-information-equality,
and a true parameter value in the interior of the parameter space),
the MLE is consistent,
and for large $n$ it has approximately a Gaussian distribution,
centered at the true parameter value $\vth$,
with covariance matrix equal to the inverse of the expected information:

{{< include sds/_subfiles/intro-MLEs/_eq_adist_mle.qmd >}}

:::

::: proof
The proof is beyond the scope of these notes;
see [@lehmannELST, Theorem 7.3.2]
and [@newey1994large].
:::
